If you have an offset antenna, enter the height and width of the antenna. If your antenna has a special shape, enter the offset angle and the size of the satellite antenna. You can find the offset angle in the manual of your satellite antenna. For parabolic antennas it is sufficient to enter the antenna diameter. With a flat antenna you do not have to set anything. If you know the exact antenna name, check if your antenna is already in the database.

STEP 2 - CHOOSE YOUR SATELLITE

If you want to receive a special satellite, switch off "AUTO": Now you can simply scroll through the table and select the satellite. Tip: Press the button for the assistant to activate the voice output.

One device serves as a camera; the second device as a monitor. What is a Booklet?
A booklet is a double sided printing you fold so it becomes a small book.
For this to work, all pages are shrunk so that two pages fit per sheet side. More over these pages are resorted so when you fold the paper, the first pages is on the front and page 2 is exactly of the backside of this page etc.

Your life will become more comfortable for just the price of a single cup of nice coffee. You get a complete solution to save a lot of paper (and thus the rainforest) and comfortably read booklets — instead of having to handle stacks of papers.

Features

• Support for Cloud Drives: Access your PDFs right from within Create Booklet. No matter if it's on iCloud, DropBox or other solutions.
• Duplex correction: We don't know why, but many printer drivers have problems with booklets. A booklet needs short-sided-binding duplex. So if your printer has trouble with that, Create Booklet has the solution: Pre-Rotated Backsides :-)
• Right to left languages: If your text is right to left, your booklet needs to be that way, too – “no problemo”.
• Landscape booklets: You have a landscape PDF? Create Booklet can make it into a landscape booklet.
• Zoom pages: If you want to e.g. fit two US Letter pages onto one US Letter sheet, this will create a margin. Create Booklet can help you with it's page zoom to minimize margins. (Still we recommend fitting formats, DIN A or US Letter onto US Legal and vice versa.)

Applause Meter is an application that works as a measurement instrument that purports to measure and display the volume of clapping or applauses made by an audience using the microphone input. It can be used to indicate the popularity of contestants and decide the result of competitions based on audience popularity.

Perfect for Events, Meetings, Contests, Battle of Bands, Lip-Sync battles and more, the winners may be determined using this App even with a big crowd. You are able to adjust the microphone sensitivity depending on the ambient sound, so the meter didn't max out every time. Use it on Landscape or Portrait (different design for each one). 

Compare and measure applause magnitude adjusting the position of the arrow to the color according to the noise level (decibels):

• Green: TEPID
• Light Green: MILD
• Yellow: SO-SO
• Orange: WILD
• Red: LOUD 

Applause-o-Meter works like a Clap-O-Meter or a Noise-O-Meter with a visual feed back.
